Greenlight Capital Has Trimmed Position in Tempur Sealy Intl (TPX) by $91.90 Million; Maple Capital Management Has Boosted Position in Apple Computer (AAPL) by $610,051 as Stock Price Rose
May 30, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
David Einhorn decreased its stake in Tempur Sealy Intl Inc (TPX) by 72.32% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greenlight Capital Inc sold 2.04M shares as the company’s stock declined 7.22% with the market. The hedge fund run by David Einhorn held 781,700 shares of the consumer durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $35.40M, down from 2.82 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greenlight Capital Inc who had been investing in Tempur Sealy Intl Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 3.94% or $1.91 during the last trading session, reaching $46.61. About 404,732 shares traded. Tempur Sealy International, Inc. (NYSE:TPX) has risen 3.45% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Maple Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 4.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maple Capital Management Inc bought 3,653 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 77,915 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.07 million, up from 74,262 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maple Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $919.97B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $187.17. About 3.64M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
